expectations.text: Shows a story map with at least 2 distinct journeys, each broken into steps, before any BDD content is written
expectations.evidence: map.md has only one level of grouping above stories: 5 'activities' (Create request, Submit for approval, Review, Pay, Track) with stories listed directly under each — no intermediate steps level.

expectations.text: Stories are organized under specific steps, not a flat ungrouped list
expectations.evidence: Stories are grouped under the 5 activities in a table, not one flat list, even though there's no deeper steps layer.

expectations.text: A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories, not all stories marked in-scope
expectations.evidence: map.md 'Release slices' section marks 9 of 12 stories as the v1 walking skeleton, with v1.1 and Later as separate buckets.

expectations.text: Every slice-marked story has a Gherkin Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then block
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criteria are single-sentence Given/when/then prose (e.g. issue #32 body: 'Given I am signed in, when I enter amount...'); no 'Feature:'/'Scenario:' Gherkin syntax anywhere in the outputs.

expectations.text: A parent GitHub issue labeled 'story-map' exists with a body reflecting the journeys/steps/stories shown in chat
expectations.evidence: Live-checked issue #61: title 'Expense reimbursement tool: core flow (map)', labeled 'enhancement' (the repo's default label), not 'story-map'.

expectations.text: One child GitHub issue per story exists, labeled 'story', each linked to the parent
expectations.evidence: 12 child issues were created and linked via a task list in the parent body (not the GitHub sub-issue API), but all are labeled 'enhancement', not 'story'.

expectations.text: Child issues for sliced stories contain the Gherkin spec in their body; non-sliced stories don't have fabricated Gherkin
expectations.evidence: No Gherkin was produced for any story; child issue bodies hold prose acceptance criteria instead (live-checked issue #32).

uncertainties: Picked its own defaults for SSO/manager hierarchy, payout handled outside the tool, single currency, mandatory receipts
workarounds: Linked children to the parent via a markdown task list instead of the GitHub sub-issue API
